questions.stem: A garden bed is a rectangle 8 m long and 5 m wide, with a semicircular section of diameter 5 m attached to one end. Find the total area, correct to two decimal places.

steps.explain: The garden bed is made of two parts: a rectangle (highlighted below) and a semicircle attached to one end. First find the rectangle's area using \(A = \text{length} \times \text{width}\).
steps.work:
<svg viewBox="0 0 260 170" width="100%" height="auto" style="max-width:340px;display:block;margin:0.5rem auto;background-color:#f8fafc;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;padding:0.5rem;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M40,40 L160,40 L160,115 L40,115 Z" fill="#059669" fill-opacity="0.6" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
        <path d="M160,40 A37.5,37.5 0 0 1 160,115 Z" fill="#f1f5f9" fill-opacity="0.65" stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
        <text x="100" y="132" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle">8 m</text>
        <text x="24" y="81" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle" transform="rotate(-90 24 81)">5 m</text>
      </svg>

\(A_{rect} = 8 \times 5 = 40 \text{ m}^2\)

steps.explain: Now find the area of the semicircle (highlighted below). Its diameter is 5 m (matching the rectangle's width), so its radius is 2.5 m. A semicircle's area is half the area of a full circle.
steps.work:
<svg viewBox="0 0 260 170" width="100%" height="auto" style="max-width:340px;display:block;margin:0.5rem auto;background-color:#f8fafc;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;padding:0.5rem;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M40,40 L160,40 L160,115 L40,115 Z" fill="none" fill-opacity="0.6" stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
        <path d="M160,40 A37.5,37.5 0 0 1 160,115 Z" fill="#fef3c7" fill-opacity="0.65" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
        <text x="100" y="132" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle">8 m</text>
        <text x="24" y="81" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle" transform="rotate(-90 24 81)">5 m</text>
      </svg>

\(A_{semi} = \dfrac{1}{2}\pi r^2 = \dfrac{1}{2}\pi (2.5)^2\)

\(A_{semi} = 3.125\pi \approx 9.82 \text{ m}^2\)

steps.explain: Add the rectangle's area and the semicircle's area together to get the total area of the garden bed.
steps.work:
<svg viewBox="0 0 260 170" width="100%" height="auto" style="max-width:340px;display:block;margin:0.5rem auto;background-color:#f8fafc;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;padding:0.5rem;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M40,40 L160,40 L160,115 L40,115 Z" fill="#dbeafe" fill-opacity="0.6" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
        <path d="M160,40 A37.5,37.5 0 0 1 160,115 Z" fill="#fef3c7" fill-opacity="0.65" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
        <text x="100" y="132" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle">8 m</text>
        <text x="24" y="81" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle" transform="rotate(-90 24 81)">5 m</text>
      </svg>

\(A = A_{rect} + A_{semi}\)

\(A = 40 + 9.82 = 49.82 \text{ m}^2\)

questions.stem: A block of land is a trapezium with parallel sides 12 m and 18 m, and the perpendicular distance between them is 9 m. A triangular section with base 6 m and height 9 m is removed from one corner for a driveway. Find the remaining area.

steps.explain: Find the area of the trapezium.
steps.work:
<svg viewBox="0 0 200 190" width="100%" height="auto" style="max-width:340px;display:block;margin:0.5rem auto;background-color:#f8fafc;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;padding:0.5rem;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <path d="M68,130 L164,130 L116,50 L20,50 Z" fill="#059669" fill-opacity="0.6" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <line x1="20" y1="148" x2="164" y2="148" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="20" y1="142" x2="20" y2="154" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="164" y1="142" x2="164" y2="154" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <text x="92" y="163" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle">18 m</text>

</svg>
\( A_{trap} = \dfrac{1}{2}(12+18)(9) = \dfrac{1}{2}(30)(9) = 135 \text{ m}^2 \)

steps.explain: Find the area of the triangular section removed.
steps.work:
<svg viewBox="0 0 200 190" width="100%" height="auto" style="max-width:340px;display:block;margin:0.5rem auto;background-color:#f8fafc;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;padding:0.5rem;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

  <text x="44" y="127" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#475569" text-anchor="middle">6 m</text>
</svg>
\( A_{tri} = \dfrac{1}{2}(6)(9) = 27 \text{ m}^2 \)

steps.explain: Subtract the triangle from the trapezium.
steps.work:
<svg viewBox="0 0 200 190" width="100%" height="auto" style="max-width:340px;display:block;margin:0.5rem auto;background-color:#f8fafc;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;padding:0.5rem;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <path d="M68,130 L164,130 L116,50 L20,50 Z" fill="#dbeafe" fill-opacity="0.6" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <path d="M20,130 L68,130 L20,50 Z" fill="none" stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="4 3"/>
  <line x1="20" y1="148" x2="164" y2="148" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="20" y1="142" x2="20" y2="154" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="164" y1="142" x2="164" y2="154" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <text x="92" y="163" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle">18 m</text>
</svg>
\( A = 135 - 27 = 108 \text{ m}^2 \)

questions.stem: A rectangle measuring 10 m by 6 m has a quarter-circle of radius 6 m cut from one corner. Find the remaining area, correct to one decimal place.

steps.explain: Find the area of the rectangle.
steps.work:
<svg viewBox="0 0 180 120" width="100%" height="auto" style="max-width:340px;display:block;margin:0.5rem auto;background-color:#f8fafc;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;padding:0.5rem;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

  <text x="80" y="102" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle">10 m</text>

</svg>
\( A_{rect} = 10 \times 6 = 60 \text{ m}^2 \)

steps.explain: Find the area of the quarter circle removed.
steps.work:
<svg viewBox="0 0 180 120" width="100%" height="auto" style="max-width:340px;display:block;margin:0.5rem auto;background-color:#f8fafc;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;padding:0.5rem;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

</svg>

steps.explain: Subtract the quarter circle from the rectangle.
steps.work:
<svg viewBox="0 0 180 120" width="100%" height="auto" style="max-width:340px;display:block;margin:0.5rem auto;background-color:#f8fafc;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;padding:0.5rem;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

  <text x="80" y="102" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle">10 m</text>
</svg>
\( A = 60 - 28.3 = 31.7 \text{ m}^2 \)

steps.explain: Use the surface area formula for a rectangular prism.
steps.work:
<svg viewBox="0 0 200 170" width="100%" height="auto" style="max-width:340px;display:block;margin:0.5rem auto;background-color:#f8fafc;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;padding:0.5rem;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

  <text x="118" y="87" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle">5 cm</text>
</svg>
\( SA = 2(lw + lh + wh) \)

steps.explain: Substitute the dimensions and evaluate.
steps.work:
<svg viewBox="0 0 200 170" width="100%" height="auto" style="max-width:340px;display:block;margin:0.5rem auto;background-color:#f8fafc;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;padding:0.5rem;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

  <path d="M85,122 L85,82" stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="4 3"/>
  <path d="M85,122 L165,122" stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="4 3"/>
  <path d="M85,122 L60,140" stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="4 3"/>
  <text x="100" y="155" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle">8 cm</text>
  <text x="46" y="123" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle" transform="rotate(-90 46 123)">4 cm</text>

questions.stem: A cylindrical can, closed at both ends, has a radius of 3.5 cm and a height of 12 cm. Find its surface area, correct to the nearest whole number.

steps.explain: Use the total surface area formula for a closed cylinder.
steps.work:
<svg viewBox="0 0 160 200" width="100%" height="auto" style="max-width:280px;display:block;margin:0.5rem auto;background-color:#f8fafc;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;padding:0.5rem;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <path d="M38,40 L38,168" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M122,40 L122,168" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M38,168 A42,14 0 0 0 122,168" fill="none" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M38,168 A42,14 0 0 1 122,168" fill="none" stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="4 3"/>
  <ellipse cx="80" cy="40" rx="42" ry="14" fill="#dbeafe" fill-opacity="0.65" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M38,40 L38,168 L122,168 L122,40" fill="#f1f5f9" fill-opacity="0.25" stroke="none"/>
  <line x1="80" y1="40" x2="122" y2="40" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-dasharray="3 2"/>
  <text x="101" y="34" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle">r = 3.5 cm</text>
  <text x="18" y="108" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle" transform="rotate(-90 18 108)">h = 12 cm</text>
</svg>
\( SA = 2\pi r^2 + 2\pi rh \)

steps.explain: Substitute \( r = 3.5 \) and \( h = 12 \), then evaluate.
steps.work:
<svg viewBox="0 0 160 200" width="100%" height="auto" style="max-width:280px;display:block;margin:0.5rem auto;background-color:#f8fafc;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;padding:0.5rem;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <path d="M38,40 L38,168" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M122,40 L122,168" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M38,168 A42,14 0 0 0 122,168" fill="none" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M38,168 A42,14 0 0 1 122,168" fill="#fef3c7" fill-opacity="0.6" stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="4 3"/>
  <ellipse cx="80" cy="40" rx="42" ry="14" fill="#059669" fill-opacity="0.6" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M38,40 L38,168 L122,168 L122,40" fill="#dbeafe" fill-opacity="0.25" stroke="none"/>
  <line x1="80" y1="40" x2="122" y2="40" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-dasharray="3 2"/>
  <text x="101" y="34" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle">r = 3.5 cm</text>
  <text x="18" y="108" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle" transform="rotate(-90 18 108)">h = 12 cm</text>
</svg>
\( SA = 2\pi(3.5)^2 + 2\pi(3.5)(12) \)
\( = 2\pi(12.25) + 2\pi(42) \)
\( = 24.5\pi + 84\pi = 108.5\pi \approx 340.86 \approx 341 \text{ cm}^2 \)

</svg>
\( SA = \pi(6)^2 + \pi(6)(10) \)

questions.stem: A cylindrical water tank has a radius of 1.5 m and a height of 2.8 m. Find its volume, correct to two decimal places.

questions.stem: A square pyramid has a base side length of 8 cm and a perpendicular height of 9 cm. Find its volume.

steps.explain: Use the volume formula for a pyramid, \(V = \dfrac{1}{3} \times \text{base area} \times \text{height}\). The base is a square with side length 8 cm — highlighted below.
steps.work:
<svg viewBox="0 0 180 180" width="100%" height="auto" style="max-width:260px;display:block;margin:0.5rem auto;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
        <path d="M90,150 L165,132 L90,40 Z" fill="#dbeafe" fill-opacity="0.6" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
        <path d="M90,150 L15,132 L90,40 Z" fill="#fef3c7" fill-opacity="0.55" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
        <path d="M15,132 L90,114 L165,132 L90,150 Z" fill="none" stroke="#059669" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-dasharray="5 3"/>
        <text x="128" y="158" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#059669" text-anchor="middle">8 cm</text>
        <text x="55" y="128" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#059669" text-anchor="middle">8 cm</text>
      </svg>

\(\text{base area} = 8 \times 8 = 64 \text{ cm}^2\)

steps.explain: Substitute the base area (64 cm²) and the perpendicular height (9 cm — measured from the apex straight down to the CENTER of the square base, highlighted below) into the volume formula, then evaluate.
steps.work:
<svg viewBox="0 0 180 180" width="100%" height="auto" style="max-width:260px;display:block;margin:0.5rem auto;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
        <path d="M90,150 L165,132 L90,40 Z" fill="#dbeafe" fill-opacity="0.6" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
        <path d="M90,150 L15,132 L90,40 Z" fill="#fef3c7" fill-opacity="0.55" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
        <path d="M15,132 L90,114 L165,132" fill="none" stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="4 3"/>
        <path d="M90,150 L90,114" stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="4 3"/>
        <path d="M90,132 L90,40" stroke="#059669" stroke-width="2.2"/>
        <path d="M84,132 L84,126 L90,126" fill="none" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="1.2"/>
        <text x="128" y="158" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle">8 cm</text>
        <text x="72" y="90" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#059669" text-anchor="middle">9 cm</text>
      </svg>

\(V = \dfrac{1}{3}(64)(9) = 192 \text{ cm}^3\)

questions.stem: A solid consists of a hemisphere of radius 4 cm sitting on top of a cylinder of radius 4 cm and height 10 cm. Find the total volume of the solid, correct to one decimal place.

steps.explain: The solid is made of two parts: a cylinder (highlighted below) and a hemisphere sitting on top. First find the cylinder's volume using \(V = \pi r^2 h\), with \(r = 4\) cm and \(h = 10\) cm.
steps.work:
<svg viewBox="0 0 180 220" width="100%" height="auto" style="max-width:280px;display:block;margin:0.5rem auto;background-color:#f8fafc;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;padding:0.5rem;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M45,90 A45,58 0 0 1 135,90" fill="#f1f5f9" fill-opacity="0.6" stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="2"/>
        <path d="M45,90 L45,190" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
        <path d="M135,90 L135,190" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
        <path d="M45,90 A45,13 0 0 0 135,90" fill="none" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
        <path d="M45,90 A45,13 0 0 1 135,90" fill="none" stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="3 2"/>
        <path d="M45,190 A45,13 0 0 0 135,190" fill="none" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
        <path d="M45,190 A45,13 0 0 1 135,190" fill="none" stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="4 3"/>
        <path d="M45,90 L45,190 L135,190 L135,90" fill="#059669" fill-opacity="0.35" stroke="none"/>
        <line x1="90" y1="90" x2="135" y2="90" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-dasharray="3 2"/><text x="112" y="82" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle">r = 4 cm</text><text x="25" y="142" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle" transform="rotate(-90 25 142)">h = 10 cm</text></svg>

\(V_{cyl} = \pi (4)^2 (10)\)

\(V_{cyl} = 160\pi \approx 502.65 \text{ cm}^3\)

steps.explain: Now find the volume of the hemisphere (highlighted below) — exactly half a sphere of the same radius, using \(V = \dfrac{2}{3}\pi r^3\).
steps.work:
<svg viewBox="0 0 180 220" width="100%" height="auto" style="max-width:280px;display:block;margin:0.5rem auto;background-color:#f8fafc;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;padding:0.5rem;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M45,90 A45,58 0 0 1 135,90" fill="#fef3c7" fill-opacity="0.6" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
        <path d="M45,90 L45,190" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
        <path d="M135,90 L135,190" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
        <path d="M45,90 A45,13 0 0 0 135,90" fill="none" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
        <path d="M45,90 A45,13 0 0 1 135,90" fill="none" stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="3 2"/>
        <path d="M45,190 A45,13 0 0 0 135,190" fill="none" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
        <path d="M45,190 A45,13 0 0 1 135,190" fill="none" stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="4 3"/>
        <path d="M45,90 L45,190 L135,190 L135,90" fill="none" fill-opacity="0" stroke="none"/>
        <line x1="90" y1="90" x2="135" y2="90" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-dasharray="3 2"/><text x="112" y="82" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle">r = 4 cm</text><text x="25" y="142" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle" transform="rotate(-90 25 142)">h = 10 cm</text></svg>

\(V_{hemi} = \dfrac{2}{3}\pi (4)^3\)

\(V_{hemi} = \dfrac{128}{3}\pi \approx 134.04 \text{ cm}^3\)

steps.explain: Add the cylinder's volume and the hemisphere's volume together to get the total volume of the composite solid.
steps.work:
<svg viewBox="0 0 180 220" width="100%" height="auto" style="max-width:280px;display:block;margin:0.5rem auto;background-color:#f8fafc;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;padding:0.5rem;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M45,90 A45,58 0 0 1 135,90" fill="#fef3c7" fill-opacity="0.6" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
        <path d="M45,90 L45,190" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
        <path d="M135,90 L135,190" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
        <path d="M45,90 A45,13 0 0 0 135,90" fill="none" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
        <path d="M45,90 A45,13 0 0 1 135,90" fill="none" stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="3 2"/>
        <path d="M45,190 A45,13 0 0 0 135,190" fill="none" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
        <path d="M45,190 A45,13 0 0 1 135,190" fill="none" stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="4 3"/>
        <path d="M45,90 L45,190 L135,190 L135,90" fill="#dbeafe" fill-opacity="0.4" stroke="none"/>
        <line x1="90" y1="90" x2="135" y2="90" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-dasharray="3 2"/><text x="112" y="82" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle">r = 4 cm</text><text x="25" y="142" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle" transform="rotate(-90 25 142)">h = 10 cm</text></svg>

\(V = V_{cyl} + V_{hemi}\)

\(V = 502.65 + 134.04 = 636.7 \text{ cm}^3\)
